data_description.base_topic: The topic Zigbee2MQTT publishes under; found on the broker when the integration was set up.
data_description.sidebar_title: Name of the panel in the sidebar.
data_description.z2m_url: Lets the panel open devices in Zigbee2MQTT. Add-on (HAOS, Supervised): the add-on's sidebar path, e.g. /45df7312_zigbee2mqtt (through its ingress, administrators only), or its frontend port once enabled, e.g. http://homeassistant:8099. Core or Container: the frontend's URL as your browser reaches it, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080, scheme included. HA on https with Zigbee2MQTT on plain http cannot be embedded; Ctrl-click then opens a tab.
